content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university with campuses in several cities. This vacancy is at its Amritapuri Campus in Kollam, Keralam. The post is in the Department of Chemistry under the School of Physical Sciences.

content_sections.heading: Research Work and Duties
content_sections.text: The fellow will work in the research group of Dr. Akhil Sivan. The group designs and synthesises heterocyclic compounds and also works on multi-component reactions, fluorescent materials and photochemical transformations. This work is used in fluorescent sensing and medicinal chemistry. The selected candidate will: develop new organic fluorophores study photoinduced processes combine experimental and computational methods to understand structure–property relationships

content_sections.heading: Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: PhD in Chemistry. The notice encourages candidates with strong expertise in synthetic organic chemistry, spectroscopic characterization and/or computational chemistry to apply. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Post Doctoral Fellow job page on the Amrita website (link below). Click "Apply Now" or "Apply Online" on that page. Fill in the online application and submit it by 30 November 2026.
